verdict.rationale: Base44 ships a scriptable CLI (login, create, deploy, run commands against any app) and an SDK with CRUD entity methods, which could be invoked in automated pipelines, and it supports agent/skill configs for automated project creation. However, there is no explicit documentation of headless/non-interactive auth, CI/CD examples, or an automation-specific mode. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline guidance, non-interactive/headless authentication flow docs, and independent confirmation of CLI use in automated environments.
